remarks: Located in the Pacific Club community in Playa del Rey, this 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence offers a comfortable layout, two private balconies, and access to a variety of community amenities. The open-concept floor plan connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating a functional space for everyday living and entertaining. A fireplace adds character to the living room, while the two balconies provide outdoor space to enjoy the outdoors. The unit’s location near the front of the building offers convenient access, and an interior laundry room adds to the home's practicality.
